name: dap-bellwether
description: A free regulatory change feed for Canada, the US, the UK and the EU, delivered as an MCP connector.

scripts.db:create: sh scripts/require-sandbox.sh && wrangler d1 create bellwether
scripts.db:migrate: sh scripts/require-sandbox.sh && wrangler d1 execute bellwether --file=./schema.sql --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: sh scripts/require-sandbox.sh && wrangler d1 execute bellwether --file=./schema.sql --local
